story: Omar and Nina look at a picture book about nature. They see many animals and different weather in the book.
title: The Nature Book
setting: A bright living room with a large book on a table.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Omar and Nina look at a big book.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔和妮娜看一本大书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt, and Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress, sit together looking at a large book.

sentences.en: The sunny weather makes them feel happy.
sentences.zh: 晴朗的天气让他们感到开心。
sentences.scene_prompt: Bright sunlight shines through a window onto Omar and Nina.

sentences.en: One page shows a tall mountain.
sentences.zh: 其中一页展示了一座高山。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture in the book shows a very high, steep mountain.

sentences.en: They see a lion and a giraffe.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了狮子和长颈鹿。
sentences.scene_prompt: The book page shows a large lion and a tall giraffe with spots.

sentences.en: A small bird sits on the grass.
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture in the book shows a small bird sitting on green grass.

sentences.en: The green plant can grow very fast.
sentences.zh: 这株绿色植物可以长得很快。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture in the book shows a green plant growing out of the soil.

sentences.en: A dog runs in the cold rain.
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture in the book shows a brown dog running through raindrops.

sentences.en: White snow and blue ice look beautiful.
sentences.zh: 白色的雪和蓝色的冰看起来很美。
sentences.scene_prompt: The book page shows white snow on the ground and blue ice.

sentences.en: Nina understands that these stories are true.
sentences.zh: 妮娜明白这些故事是真的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress, smiles while looking at the book.

sentences.en: She thinks about a warm Christmas fire.
sentences.zh: 她想到了温暖的圣诞节篝火。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina imagines a cozy fireplace with a Christmas tree nearby.
